_note: svelte2tsx and the compiler's preprocess find scripts with a regular expression that needs a literal `</script>`, so a module script closed by `</script >` runs on to the instance script's close tag and both read as one module script. svelte2tsx rewrites the swallowed `</script >` (TypeScript's `<`, an empty type, and a regular expression) to `/script > as `, whose unterminated regular expression is TS1161 at the `/`. When that one script is `lang="ts"`, the no-config fallback preprocessor transpiles it and acorn stops at the same `/` with a js_parse_error; a plain JavaScript module script is not transpiled, and the compiler reads both scripts as the Svelte parser does.
